config.seed_rule: seed(shape, rep i) = seed_base + seed_offsets[shape] + i
config.sampling: without replacement, sorted indices stored per replicate

reference_overlap_guard: The full-data reference OVERLAPS each 80% subsample: distances are descriptive resampling stability, not independent validation and not an unbiased generalization estimate. The spread of the 30 distances is a variability band, not a formal confidence set.
methodology_note_metric_vs_test: Bottleneck and Wasserstein distances are METRICS between persistence diagrams. Reporting their values across resamples is NOT a statistical hypothesis test: there is no null distribution, no p-value, and no rejection region anywhere in this extension.
essential_class_handling: persim 0.4.1 bottleneck/wasserstein drop points with non-finite death times (the essential H0 class) from both diagrams before computing distances; distances concern finite classes only.
runtime_note: wall-clock accumulated across resumable invocations; per-replicate ripser and distance timings are recorded individually
